title: Bonafide Certificate Template
description: Free bonafide certificate format for schools and colleges in India with student name, roll and admission no., course, academic year, purpose and principal's seal. Edit in Word, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Excel or Overleaf.
features: Institution letterhead with affiliation code and certificate number
Student, course, roll no. and academic year details
Purpose line, principal's signature and office seal area
useCases: Visa, bank account and internship verification
research: References agree on an official letterhead, certificate no. and date, the student's name with parent's name, class/course, roll or admission no., academic year and period of study, the purpose of issue, and the principal's or registrar's signature with the office seal.

blocks.title: BONAFIDE

text: This is to certify that **[Aditi Ramesh]**, daughter of **[Mr. K. Ramesh]**, is a bonafide student of this school, studying in **[Class XI, Science (PCMB)]**, Section **[B]**, during the academic year **[2026-27]**.
As per our admission register, she was admitted on **[03/06/2022]** under Admission No. **[SVN/2022/1147]**. Her date of birth as recorded in the school register is **[14/08/2010]**.
To the best of our knowledge, she bears a good moral character and her conduct in school has been **[good]**.
This certificate is issued at the request of the student's parent for the purpose of **[applying for the State Merit Scholarship 2026-27]** and is not valid for any other purpose.

blocks.heading: Note
text: This certificate is valid only with the school seal and the original signature of the Principal. It confirms enrolment for the period stated and is valid for [6 months] from the date of issue. Verification: [office@srividyaniketan.edu.in].

blocks.text: Issued under the authority of the Principal. Any alteration or overwriting makes this certificate invalid.
